Q1. Which exact area should this issue target?
Choices:
A. A workflow file under `.github/workflows/` — reply with the filename(s)
B. A helper script under `scripts/` — reply with the path(s)
C. Docs / prompts / tests — reply with the path(s)
D. Another specific component — reply with the exact path or component name (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What does “better” mean for that area?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug — describe the current behavior and the expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Reduce cost / noise / latency — describe what is too expensive, noisy, or slow and what must stay unchanged
C. Improve docs / usability — describe what is missing, unclear, or incorrect
D. Another outcome — describe the exact current → desired result (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What concrete example should planning anchor on?
Choices:
A. A workflow run, issue, or PR number that shows the problem (RECOMMENDED)
B. A short reproducible example in plain English (RECOMMENDED)
C. No example is available; rely only on the description I provide
